title: Artifacts vanilla-styled
description: Overhauls textures of the Artifacts mod items
body:
This pack is my personal take on the [Artifacts mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts), remade to be more like vanilla. I do not like plastic or stuff like that in artifacts, so i wanted to remake it. I am not really a designer or a texturer pro though, so some of them will be changed in the future!

# Featuring for now:
## Scuba mask
![Scuba mask](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22d0056f1095aa7cf1f8d1b0d632b7c9590123b4.png)
## Runner boots (renamed to Hermes sandals)
![Hermes sandals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34222247ed51e30d5e555d4a3b614cf4644231ec.png)
## Night vision goggles
![Night vision goggles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/194bc261dad860b8bea90f8440a17b473c83c344.png)
## Flippers
![Flippers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bac09bb777cbbedd9d59901caa5cf8952e4574ad.png)
And they also look cool with scuba masc and Alex caves diving armor:
![Yep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb81ce7fc22809c3c3e3603829acb489a38b16bf.png)
# Upcoming:
- ~~Night vision goggles~~
- Plastic and Novelty drinking hat
- ~~Flippers~~
- Hermes boots item rework (i will get better at drawing, trust)
